name: Adastack.io
description_short: Cardano ecosystem explorer and intro guide hub.
description_long: Open-source Cardano ecosystem explorer: intro guides, wallets, DApps, NFTs, games, governance, Project Catalyst, DAOs, development, sidechains, L2s and more. Built with a modern React/Next.js stack, MIT-licensed, with 1,500+ curated tools and links across 100+ resource pages and a public REST API.
